senses.sense_definition: The condition or quality of being distinguished, superior, or widely recognized; high reputation or station.

examples.text: Her <w>eminence</w> as an author was recognized with numerous prestigious literary prizes.

target_lang_definitions.nl: De toestand of kwaliteit van voornaamheid, superioriteit of wijdverbreide erkenning; hoge reputatie of aanzien.
